# interestfor 1.0.14

Source: https://github.com/mfreed7/interestfor (npm `interestfor@1.0.14`).

Unmodified `src/interestfor.min.js`, conditionally imported only when the browser lacks native `HTMLButtonElement.prototype.interestForElement`. Used for the ninth-floor label's hover/focus preview. No CDN or runtime network dependency.
